newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee dips in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee dips in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee opened 0.08 down in the kerb market at 40.19 to the dollar on Sunday as dollar supply tightened, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to close lower as dollar inflows from the Gulf were not enough to meet demand, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on September 10, stayed at 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates opened at 8.90 percent, compared to the last closing at 8.70 percent.
